subject: PO laddering and provisional limit for Ava Supply onboarding
messages:
From: Ava Supply <procurement@avasupply.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: Evan Liu <evan.liu@marketops.io>
Date: 2026-12-03T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: Initial vendor packet + suggested lineitems for PO issuance

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist — attached is our suggested line-item breakdown for the first quarter (avasupply_onboard_lineitems_v1.xlsx). We flagged the three SKUs that need separate PO lines and added a monthly spend cadence.

Two quick asks so we can start:
- Can Redwood issue a provisional PO (one-time) that we can reference in our invoice while account setup completes?
- We'd prefer a spend cap laddering (monthly increments) rather than a single lump-sum cap. Is that supported for new vendors?

I've copied Evan from our finance team in case you need additional details.

Best,
Maya Patel
Vendor Ops, Ava Supply
procurement@avasupply.com

Attachments: avasupply_onboard_lineitems_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Ava Supply <procurement@avasupply.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-03T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial vendor packet + suggested lineitems for PO issuance

Hi Maya — thanks for sending this over and the clear line-item notes. Quick notes from our side:

- We can issue a provisional PO for onboarding but need finance confirmation on the provisional amount.
- Spend cap laddering is supported; we typically structure it as Month1=25% / Month2=50% / Month3=100% of committed cap for the initial 90-day window.
- We need unit prices per SKU confirmed (the sheet has ranges). If you can lock those, we can mirror them into the PO lines.

@Priyom / @Connor: Priyom — can you confirm whether we can provision a PO at 30k provisional for Ava (pending final pricing)? Connor — if finance greenlights, we will need a temporary PO doc (PO-Temp-XXXX) and a note in the ledger that this is provisional for onboarding.

Next step: if Priyom confirms the provisional amount, I'll send the PO template to Maya for signature and route to Laura in billing for issuance.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-03T13:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial vendor packet + suggested lineitems for PO issuance

Hannah — confirmed we can do a provisional issuance. Suggested provisional amount: $30,000 to cover Month1 cadence and initial inventory. This matches the onboarding budget bucket. A few conditions:

- The provisional PO will be flagged in our ledger as "provisional-onboard" and expires after 60 days unless converted.
- Finance requires an explicit SKU-unit price or a max per-line cap to avoid ambiguous invoicing.
- If Ava wants laddering, the accounting team prefers explicit monthly caps (we can do 7.5k / 15k / 30k ramp or 25/50/100 percent — up to vendor to select).

I'll loop Laura to prep the PO-Temp-8871 PDF once Hannah confirms the exact numbers.

— Priyom
Director, ProcureOps
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Supply <procurement@avasupply.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-04T11:09:00-08:00
Subject: PO-Temp-8871 (provisional) and line-item alignment request

Hi Maya — attaching a provisional PO for onboarding (PO-Temp-8871.pdf). Before we finalize:

1) Please confirm unit prices for the three flagged SKUs in your spreadsheet.
2) Indicate which laddering option you prefer: A) 25/50/100% monthly ramp, or B) fixed amounts: $7,500 / $15,000 / $30,000.
3) If you anticipate any vendor tax exemptions, please attach the certificate so we can reflect that on the PO.

We're tentatively holding 30k as the provisional cap pending your confirmation. Once you reply we will:
- Convert the provisional PO to an active PO number (if everything matches)
- Upload the PO into the procurement ledger and share the DocuSign link if you need a signature

Thanks — attaching PO-Temp-8871.pdf for reference.

Attachments: PO-Temp-8871.pdf (provisional PO stub)

Best,
Laura Bennett
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Ava Supply <procurement@avasupply.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: Evan Liu <evan.liu@marketops.io>
Date: 2026-12-06T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO-Temp-8871 (provisional) and line-item alignment request

Hi Laura / Hannah — thanks for the quick turnaround and the provisional PO. Answers below:

- Unit prices confirmed and locked in the updated sheet (see attached). We removed ranges and set firm per-unit rates for the three SKUs.
- We prefer laddering option B: fixed monthly amounts $7,500 / $15,000 / $30,000.
- No tax exemptions to report at this time.

Please convert PO-Temp-8871 into an active PO number and let us know the final PO number to reference on our first invoice.

We attached the revised spreadsheet and a brief note of our invoicing cadence. If you need anything else we can jump on a 15-minute call.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Vendor Ops, Ava Supply
Attachments: avasupply_onboard_lineitems_v1.xlsx (updated with fixed prices)
